ashwin raman: Morning all — I'm Ashwin, starting on Platform Eng (IC3) today! Quick setup questions to not block myself:
- Do we have an MDM flow for Apple Silicon (M1/M2) Macs or should I wait for the IT laptop?
- Who do I ping for stickers + keyboard cover? :stuck_out_tongue_winking_eye:
- Need access to Redwood Console (read/write for my org), the 'dev-dedicated' cluster, and please add me to #eng-oncall so I can see the pager rotation. I'm in IST (+5:30) if that matters for oncall shifts. Thanks!

tara (people ops): Welcome Ashwin!! :tada:
- MDM: Please enroll via this link: https://mdm.redwood.example/enroll and choose "Company Mac - M1/M2". IT usually pushes the provisioning profile within ~30 mins.
- Stickers: DM @tara with your mailing address, we'll ship the welcome pack (stickers + sticker laptop sleeve).
- Console & cluster: I can kick off the access tickets, but please confirm the org slug you need (e.g., redwood-internal). Also I'll add you to the onboarding doc + assign a buddy.

liam (devex): Hey Ashwin — hi! I'm your buddy for the first week. Happy to do a quick 15-min setup call if you want. A few things that speed things up:
- Add your SSH pubkey to https://id.redwood.example/account/ssh-keys
- To test jump host access:
```
ssh -i ~/.ssh/id_rsa ashwin@jump.redwood.com
```
- VPN: use the 'redwood-wireguard' profile in the WireGuard app, creds are your SSO. If you hit a cert error, paste the exact message here and I'll help.

nina (eng): Added you to #eng-oncall and the rotation. You should get a Slack DM from PagerDuty once your user is provisioned. For the 'dev-dedicated' cluster, please fill this short request form: https://forms.redwood.example/dev-cluster-request and mention "ashwin raman, platform eng, dev-dedicated (small)". Ops will approve within a day usually.

mdm-bot: Enrollment received for ashwin.ram@example.com. Device type: MacBookPro (arm64). Provisioning in progress — status: pending (30m ETA).

ashwin raman: Thanks everyone — will enroll now and DM @tara my address. Liam — a 15-min call later today (IST afternoon) would be great. I'll fill the cluster form in a minute. :raised_hands:

liam (devex): Cool — ping me when you're on WireGuard, we'll screenshare to finish SSH & Console perms.
